 Close form Send us your views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Jess Anderson
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 17:32 GMT 17:32 GMT 
 HT: Man Utd 2-2 Aston Villa 
 Roy Keane 
Former Manchester United captain on Sky Sports 
 Nightmare start for United, they never got going. Villa looked sharp. 
 The keeper has to be doing better. It's poor from United and it was a standard save. Villa probably couldn't have believed their luck, but then they gave United a helping hand.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17:30 GMT 17:30 GMT 
 HT: Man Utd 2-2 Aston Villa 
 Ashley Young 
Former Man Utd winger on Sky Sports 
 Aston Villa were the brighter team. They started bright and quick with intent.
 On the opening goal Diogo Dalot has to defend his goal and slide in. The goalkeeper doesn't do himself any glory. Since the World Cup he [Sene Lammens] made that mistake and he hasn't looked the same.
 59 26 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 17:28 GMT 17:28 GMT 
 Click 'get involved' to send us your views 
 Great comeback, hoping it might shut up the sack the manager crowd. Bringing someone new in will make no difference as it's the same team. What we need is time, next summer sort the defence and extra striker out.
 Stuart Klikucs 
 A woeful first 10 minutes, but an amazing response from the United players, to be fair.
 Tim 
 315 203 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Both sides have been really committed' published at 17:25 GMT 17:25 GMT 
 HT: Man Utd 2-2 Aston Villa 
 Andy Reid 
Former Republic of Ireland midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Take all the circus that went around the game beforehand, and it's been an excellent game of football. 
 Both sides have been really committed to play attacking football. It's been really competitive. Other than the first five minutes for Man United, they've actually been really aggressive, Villa have done the same when they've overturned the ball. 
 There's been some brilliant passages of play, we've seen some good goals and chances. The midfield battle has been fascinating. 
 256 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17:24 GMT 17:24 GMT 
 HT: Man Utd 2-2 Aston Villa 
 Where do you even start with that?
 Aston Villa 2-0 up inside four minutes then Manchester United get back on level terms thanks to a penalty and a goal for Youri Tielemans against his former side.
 United looked absolutely shellshocked after conceding those early goals but you have to say it has been a remarkable response from the hosts.
 Michael Carrick ran down the tunnel as the whistle blew - clearly desperate to impart some words of wisdom on his players.
 381 128 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 17:21 GMT 17:21 GMT 
 Man Utd 2-2 Aston Villa 
 What a half of football.
 856 222 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17:21 GMT 17:21 GMT 
 Man Utd 2-2 Aston Villa 
 A high boot from Bruno Fernandes has Villa claiming for a penalty but it's checked and cleared.
 At the other end, Amad slides the ball across for Matheus Cunha but he misses it and there's no one else there to sweep up.
 175 441 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 45+3 mins 45+3 mins 
 Man Utd 2-2 Aston Villa 
 Can Manchester United pull off two 3-2 comebacks in one week?
 1174 1101 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Goalkeeper Suzuki could have done better' published at 17:19 GMT 17:19 GMT 
 Man Utd 2-2 Aston Villa 
 Andy Reid 
Former Republic of Ireland midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 I think Bryan Mbeumo is right in front of the keepers view and I think the Villa players are arguing he blocked his view. 
 He's not offside because there's a deeper defender. The goal was really well worked.
 Youri Tielemans come on with his left foot, the goalkeeper gets his hand to it but could have done better than that. I think they do deserve to be even in this game. 
 513 473 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 45+2 mins 45+2 mins 
 Man Utd 2-2 Aston Villa 
 What a game this has been!
 Aston Villa almost fashion the perfect response as Alysson is released down the right-hand side and Senne Lammens comes out to make the save but the Brazilian has already got his shot away. Luckily for United it drops wide of the far post.
 344 224 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Man Utd 2-2 Aston Villa published at 17:16 GMT 17:16 GMT 
 Youri Tielemans (44 mins) 
 What a turnaround!
 Noussair Mazraoui chops the ball back from close to the byline and Youri Tielemans is there to lash into the back of the net against his former club.
 What a moment that is for the Belgian. The comeback is well and truly on! 
 VAR has a quick look for offside but the goal stands.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 3776 3977 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 43 mins 43 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Aston Villa get away with one!
 Boubacar Kamara loses the ball cheaply and it comes to Amad, who goes for the low shot and Zion Suzuki parries away.
 The rebound doesn't fall kindly for United and Villa are able to clear.
 303 175 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 17:12 GMT 17:12 GMT 
 Use 'Get involved' to have your say 
 Regardless of the result, I think United have to make a change at manager. The team is too shakey to continue like this and waiting much later will all but confirm the club's relegation.
 Andrew, Corinth 
 827 1993 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 39 mins 39 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Noussair Mazraoui is fuming as he concedes a free-kick near the edge of his own penalty box when Johan Manzambi steps in.
 John McGinn sends it in and Pau Torres gets to the header but can't get it on target.
 232 116 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 38 mins 38 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Amad chops round Ian Maatsen and drills a shot with his left foot towards the bottom far corner but it drags just wide.
 303 146 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'There's a battle in midfield' published at 17:08 GMT 17:08 GMT 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Andy Reid 
Former Republic of Ireland midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 There's an interesting tactical battle going on in the midfield. Boubacar Kamara and Leon Goretzka are playing that bottom two pivots for Villa and John McGinn and Johan Manzambi are playing higher. 
 But then Matheus Cunha is coming in and so is Bruno Fernandes. Villa are leaving them all that space. It's an interesting battle. 
 310 95 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 35 mins 35 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Amad peels off and tries to make the run in behind but the ball up from midfield has a bit too much on it for him to latch onto.
 172 115 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 17:04 GMT 17:04 GMT 
 Use 'Get involved' to have your say 
 As a Man City fan I can accept City being relegated if they have broken the rules. But I am terrified that may then save United from being relegated if they finish 18th!
 Phil, Northumberland 
 2544 554 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 33 mins 33 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Fair play to Manchester United fans they have been so up for this.
 They are willing their side on, desperate to see them get a winning result here.
 637 665 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 31 mins 31 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Man Utd have lost 21 of their last 22 Premier League matches when trailing by 2+ goals (D1) - their last victory was against Aston Villa at Old Trafford on Boxing Day 2023 (won 3-2).
